- `real-systemone-2026-10-04.json` — a real request to d1 (`d1:free`) and its
  response, recorded with the SDK on 2026-10-04. No key inside.
- `synthetic-systemone.json` — hand-written from the SDK's response types before
  a key was available. Round numbers, handy for unit tests of the shape; the real
  recording is the reference.
